objective: Implement the first bounded ROS 2 LifecycleNode bridge for the existing DeviceRuntime and SocketCAN adapter without changing frozen public schemas or safety ownership.
decision_supported: Issue #230 acceptance for a concrete SocketCAN-to-read-only-consumer path, delayed ROS 2 lifecycle integration, bounded projection draining, explicit QoS/domain settings, and truthful loopback evidence.
acceptance: The ROS-free bridge core reuses one DeviceRuntime and accepts only immutable validated CanExternalRecord and CanDiagnostic projections through an explicit field allowlist.

Telemetry, ACK/action-result and health publications have separate bounded QoS definitions, fixed per-tick drain work and observable source queue/drop metrics; an unsupported or non-exposed object is never serialized.
The ROS 2 integration delays rclpy imports until its factory is called, creates a LifecycleNode with lifecycle publishers and a bounded timer, and does not require ROS 2 to import workbench.hardware.

Lifecycle configure, activate, deactivate, cleanup and shutdown are fail-closed and idempotent at the bridge boundary; deactivation stops the existing runtime and a later activation recreates a clean adapter/runtime without an orphan worker or stale projection.

The default SocketCAN factory wires SocketCANTransport into SafeCANBus while leaving Fast DDS as a deployment-selected RMW and keeping commands, E-stop, watchdog, safe-enable and direct motion authority outside the bridge.
The bridge records domain ID, RMW selection, topic names, reliability/history/depth, executor thread bound, queue capacities and security profile without changing interfaces/ schemas.
Unit tests cover strict parameter validation, JSON allowlisting, bounded drain and publisher failure, queue/drop accounting, lifecycle failure and restart cleanup, and a fake SocketCAN adapter path.

Documentation and test evidence distinguish ROS/fake/virtual loopback behavior from physical CAN, MCU, actuator, PREEMPT_RT and hard-real-time evidence; unexecuted physical evidence remains NOT_EXECUTED.
evidence: ROS-free focused unit test output and Ruff check/format output
ROS 2 Jazzy lifecycle smoke output when the host environment is available
required repository test, contract, scenario, context and documentation checks
scoped diff review with explicit virtual-versus-physical evidence limits
owner review from Integration, Motion and Perception for lifecycle, QoS, source metadata and safety boundaries
stop_conditions: A public interface/schema, firmware, robot-control or service implementation change is required.
The bridge needs a second unbounded worker, queue, lifecycle owner, direct DDS hardware callback or raw device handle.
DDS would become the E-stop, watchdog, safe-enable or direct motion authority.
A ROS or virtual SocketCAN loopback result would be used as physical CAN, MCU, actuator, PREEMPT_RT or hard-real-time evidence.
The existing DeviceRuntime cannot be stopped and recreated within the configured bounded shutdown deadline.
A required change falls outside the allowed paths or requires an unapproved owner decision.
data_classification: validated device telemetry, health metadata and deployment configuration; no credentials, sockets or device write handles
model_policy: No model output is admitted as a hardware command, lifecycle decision, safety state, DDS configuration authority or physical evidence.
